reference.title: [던파] 진(眞) 웨펀마스터
reference.inspection: Browser video frames inspected at 1-second intervals from 0 to 47 seconds, plus full-size frames at 4, 11, 18, 25, 32, 41 and 48 seconds. Multi-sword sequence rechecked at 12.6, 13.0, 13.4, 13.8, 14.2, 14.6, 15.0, 15.4 and 15.8 seconds, plus repeat at 29–31 seconds.

skills.label: 창천 종단

skills.effect: wide diagonal spatial cut followed by separated ground fracture and dissipating ribbons

weaponPolicy: Select visible original sword blade and guard pixels from V3; one immutable raster; only translation, rotation, uniform scale and horizontal facing reflection; short grip is drawn with the hands. Never resize weapon independently per pose.
proportions: Adult heroic body, compact complete helmet, athletic torso, long thighs/shins; no chibi or SD proportion change; canonical physical height shared across all actions; crouched/jumping bounds never normalize apparent stature.
runtime: Existing common V3 BattleEngine, one PixiJS and one GSAP clock; visual events only.
